kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: Black Sheep

attribution.author: Black Sheep
attribution.source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/122711 (Key Authors: Black Sheep; submitter black sheep)

notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a scored race-and-fight round. 27 and 24 team spawns, 37 game_score entities awarding points per level end and per fail (lvl_1_end_trig, lvl_2_fail_trig, ...), two jails with timers, 21 func_breakables, placed weapons (deagle, m249, grenades) and two game_player_equip. Its levels are scored against each other rather than timed from a line, and the winner's room is a kill box. gb-maps-2. Not published.

round_teleports.note: the jail teleports (`jail_1_*`, `jail_2_*`, seven brushes each over the spawn and the levels) are enabled by the jail timers, and `IFAILED` by a level's fail teleport; until then each starts disabled. This game runs no round, so imported they were pits round the spawn that sent a player who walked out and back in to the spawn (headless_imported: 'never touches a pit on the way down', 2026-10-11). Dropped, as the map is at the start of a round
